name: goby-review
description: Code review with kernel-checked review and gate policies

scripts.build: bun build src/reviewRun.ts --target=node --outfile=dist/reviewRun.js && bun build src/progressCli.ts --target=node --outfile=dist/progress.js && bun build scripts/gate.ts --target=node --outfile=dist/gate.js && bun build src/wakeCli.ts --target=node --outfile=dist/wake.js
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run proof && bun run build && bun run test
